_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. These are starting values for a first column grid, not the result of a structural calculation.
_doc: The columns stand on a regular grid of axes, one at every crossing inside the building. width / depth: size of a column in metres, along x and along y of the plan. maxSpan: the largest distance between two neighbouring axes; a longer one is divided evenly by axes in between. minSpan: the smallest distance between two neighbouring axes; an axis wanted closer than this to one already taken is dropped.
